title: Rav Chana bar Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Sukkah 52b, saying: “In the school of Rav they say: Four things the Holy One, blessed be He, regrets having created: exile, the Chaldeans, the Ishmaelites and the evil inclination.” Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Chana bar Ada, and Ein Yaakov reads Ravin bar Rav Acha.
